## Self-review checklist

- [ ] Branch is `<type>/<issue#>-<short-slug>`, commits are conventional (`feat:`, `fix:`, …)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] Types: `mypy --strict` passes (pre-commit / CI)
- [ ] Lint: `ruff check` and `ruff format` pass
- [ ] New settings are in `.env.example`; no secrets or personal data committed
- [ ] Docs updated where needed (README, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/`, ADR for notable decisions)
- [ ] I read my own diff once more on GitHub before merging
